msg: I initially tried to make a decision based on the style of hat the gnomes were wearing. To begin, those wearing the short hats seemed to give better results but this didn't last long and there were pairings where neither had a short hat. I then began to look at the colour of the hats as two colours were paired together each time, for e.g. always yellow and pink or always green and brown. After a few initial picks to see what the results were like for each colour in any pair, I felt that I was obtaining better results opting for one specific colour of hat. This seemed to be quite consistent until a certain point when the initial colour choice began having poor results and on trying the other colour in the pairing I found it was offering better results, it seemed as though the colours had swapped the level of results they gave. Further on in the game this change seemed to take place again and the colours swapped back. I would suggest doing a few checks to see which colour in a pair gives better results then seeing if this gives any consistency. If the method does appear to work but then stops, try changing to the other colour.
